maya: Quick smoke run summary for GPTQ compatibility across families (Llama2-13B, Mistral-7B, Qwen-7B). Pulled MMLU / HumanEval and a few qual notes. Asking: deploy risk? canary suggestions?
arden: Thanks — can you paste the deltas?
maya: pasted quick table below (small sample, eval harness v0.9.3, seed=42):
```
Model             | Metric     | fp16  | gptq-int8 / awq | delta
Llama2-13B        | MMLU       | 76.4  | 74.6            | -1.8
Llama2-13B        | HumanEval p@1| 27.2 | 26.1            | -1.1
Mistral-7B        | MMLU       | 72.1  | 71.3 (AWQ)      | -0.8
Mistral-7B        | HumanEval  | 18.9  | 18.5            | -0.4
Qwen-7B           | MMLU       | 69.0  | 65.8            | -3.2
Qwen-7B           | HumanEval  | 15.4  | 13.9            | -1.5
Throughput (tokens/s): fp16 -> gptq-int8/awq ~ 1x -> 2.6-3.0x
Memory reduction: ~30-40% depending on group-size
```
sam: who ran Qwen? -3.2 is big, was that a straight GPTQ with default group size?
maya: I ran Qwen with gptq (bits=8, group=128) from our fork; noticed tokenization misaligns on a few QA examples — some answers truncated / repeated.
lee: Qwen has different tokenizer behavior for some edge prefixes, we've seen sampling drift after quant in convo logs before. Did you try safe-kv/kv-preserve?
maya: not in this pass. used `--safe-kv false` for speed. re-run with `--safe-kv true` next.
zara: Mistral results look solid for AWQ — <1pt hit is acceptable for many workloads. For customer-facing completions I'd still prefer a canary at 2% traffic.
arden: agree. propose rollout plan: 1) Mistral-AWQ canary 2% with latency & eval gating 2) Llama-GPTQ gradual canary but keep fp16 fallback for edge cases 3) Qwen: hold until we run kv-preserve + tokenization sanity and regen eval set.
eval-bot: automated regression check results uploaded to /s3/evals/gptq_smoke/1918462023/ — baseline-to-gptq diff summary attached.
maya: quick notes on config used: `python tools/convert.py --model MODEL --method gptq --bits 8 --group-size 128 --quant-backend awq` and `python eval/run_all.py --harness v0.9.3 --seed 42 --samples 500`.
sam: can we add a small human-read spotcheck for Qwen on 50 conversational threads? if tokenization issues are present they show up fast.
maya: will queue that. also adding KV-preserve toggle in next run. expecting ~2 hours for full pass on our 8xA100 bench.
lee: perf/op notes: on p3-ish hardware GPTQ gave ~2.7x token throughput vs fp16; cold-start latency slightly higher due to quant-decompression step but steady-state latency improved.
zara: sounds good. CI guard: block any rollout that increases hallucination rate on our prompt set by >1.5x.
maya: action items: (maya) rerun Qwen with `--safe-kv true` + tokenization check, (arden) draft canary policy for Mistral-AWQ, (sam) 50-thread human spotcheck, (lee) add perf delta numbers into the console dashboard. Target: reconvene tomorrow EOD with updated numbers.
sam: +1
arden: +1
lee: noted
maya: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
